package main

// 地図を組み立てる関数が描画（ebiten）に触る作品。手元で動かさずに判定しない。

import "github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2"

const (
	rows     = 5
	cols     = 5
	tileSize = 16
	tileWall = 1
)

var roomMaps [1][rows][cols]int
var keyPos = [1][2]int{{2, 2}}
var exitPos = [1][2]int{{3, 3}}
var wallImg *ebiten.Image

func buildMaps() {
	wallImg = ebiten.NewImage(tileSize, tileSize)
	for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
		roomMaps[0][0][x] = tileWall
	}
	roomMaps[0][keyPos[0][1]][keyPos[0][0]] = 0
	roomMaps[0][exitPos[0][1]][exitPos[0][0]] = 0
}

type Game struct{ px, py float64 }

func (g *Game) reset() {
	buildMaps()
	g.px = float64(1*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.py = float64(1*tileSize + tileSize/2)
}

func main() {}
